title: Blue Rancher (Zero Nicotine) Geek Bar Pulse X 25000
description:
Blue Rancher (Zero Nicotine) Geek Bar Pulse X 25000
A Burst of Flavor
Looking for a bold vaping experience without nicotine? The Blue Rancher Geek Bar Pulse X 25000 delivers just that! Packed with vibrant flavors that dance on your taste buds, this disposable vape redefines satisfaction with every puff while keeping it zero-nicotine-friendly.
Disposable Convenience Meets Incredible Taste
No more refills, no more hassle. Designed for ease, the Geek Bar Pulse X 25000 is perfect for those who want premium flavor without the fuss of maintaining a device. Simply unwrap, enjoy, and dispose responsibly.
Flavor That Keeps You Coming Back
Indulge in the Blue Rancher’s tantalizing taste profile, blending fruity notes with a refreshing sweetness that guarantees an unforgettable vaping experience. Each vape is carefully crafted to ensure a smooth and consistent flavor with every draw.
Key Features
Puff Count
:
Up to 25,000 (Regular Mode) or 15,000 (Pulse Mode)
E-liquid
:
18mL, 0% nicotine
Battery
:
820mAh rechargeable (USB-C)
Display
:
Smart 3D Curved LED Screen
Coils
:
Dual Mesh for superior flavor
Modes
:
Soft, Normal, Pulse
Airflow: Adjustable for customized draw
Elevate Your Vaping Journey
With its sleek and portable design, the Geek Bar Pulse X 25000 fits effortlessly into your lifestyle. Perfect for flavor enthusiasts seeking convenience and a nicotine-free option without sacrificing quality.
Taste the difference. Elevate your vape. Try Blue Rancher today!
